levels.name: No security target
levels.description: The target scenario cannot be resolved or scanned as a repository scenario.

levels.name: Substrates classified
levels.description: Security-health can detect supported and unsupported substrates and report degraded scanner context without failing availability.
exit_criteria: Detected Go, pnpm, and unsupported substrates are represented in the validation report

levels.name: Safety blockers absent
levels.description: No scanner reports an ERROR-class secret, SAST, reachable vulnerability, or production dependency vulnerability.
exit_criteria: No ERROR findings are emitted by security scanners

levels.name: Scanner coverage available
levels.description: Applicable scanner classes are installed or their absence is deliberately understood as degraded context.
exit_criteria: Absent or degraded scanners have been resolved or explicitly accepted

levels.name: Dependency intelligence indexed
levels.description: Dependency exposure can be searched through the security-health dependency corpus and index surfaces.
exit_criteria: Dependency records are indexed and searchable through structured or semantic search

levels.name: Continuous security posture
levels.description: The scenario is ready for continuous fleet security posture monitoring and badge/UI surfaces.
exit_criteria: Validation, dependency search, and posture surfaces can support continuous fleet monitoring
